name: io.fyno.pushlibrary.mipush.MiPushHelper
description: When Xiaomi Mi Push delivers or registers a message for Fyno, this Fyno Push Library receiver handles the message, displays Fyno notifications, and saves the Xiaomi push token.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops Fyno push delivery through Xiaomi services and token updates; the host app's regular features remain available.
